days.title: 크루즈 탑승, 만 탐험
days.morning: Drive from Hanoi on the expressway (about 2.5 hours) and board your cruise at Tuan Chau harbour.
days.afternoon: Visit Sung Sot Cave and kayak around Luon Cave.
days.evening: Watch the sunset from the deck, enjoy a seafood dinner and night squid fishing.

days.title: 티톱 섬과 수상 마을
days.morning: Tai chi at sunrise, then climb Ti Top peak for a panoramic view.
days.afternoon: Visit Cua Van fishing village, check out of the cruise and return to the harbour.
days.evening: Stroll Sun World Ha Long, ride the Sun Wheel and stay in Bai Chay.

days.title: 박물관과 해산물 시장
days.morning: Quang Ninh Museum with its striking "black box" architecture.
days.afternoon: Take the Queen cable car up Ba Deo hill for bird's-eye bay views.
days.evening: Shop for squid cakes and sea worms at Ha Long 1 market.

days.title: 란하베이 – 깟바
days.morning: Take the boat to Cat Ba island and kayak Lan Ha Bay.
days.afternoon: Swim at Ba Trai Dao beach and visit Cai Beo fishing village.
days.evening: Stay in Cat Ba town and eat seafood on a floating raft.

days.title: 신성한 옌뜨산
days.morning: Head to Uong Bi and ride the cable car to the Bronze Pagoda on Yen Tu peak.
days.afternoon: Visit Truc Lam Yen Tu Zen Monastery and Nu village.
days.evening: Try bánh gio rice cakes and Yen Tu bamboo shoots.
